notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 350080 was used. The store list has two apps named "Wolfenstein: The Old Blood" (350080 and 354830); both return the same 50-achievement schema named "Project Iron" (an internal codename). Nothing in the data says how they differ; RAWG also has a separate "Wolfenstein: The Old Blood German Edition" entry, which may be related, so the coordinator may want to check. StrategyWiki has no page under "Wolfenstein: The Old Blood" or "Wolfenstein The Old Blood". wolfenstein.fandom.com answers the API under "Wolfenstein: The Old Blood", with about 183 linked articles, including chapter pages from "Prologue - German Alps" and "Chapter 1 - Prison" to "Chapter 8 - Dig Site"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 50 Steam achievements is hidden. The data does not say which chapters make up part one, so the two story chapters follow the achievements ("Escape Castle Wolfenstein", "Complete part one", "Complete game"); placing the Kessler and Annette choices in part two is a guess.
